summary: RAG few-shot on champion LoRA adapter
hypothesis: Injecting RAG few-shot demonstrations into the champion fine-tuned adapter should push quality beyond the adapter-only plateau, because the adapter already captures good judgment and in-context exemplars can further sharpen topical coverage and phrasing.
technique: Nearest gold exemplars are retrieved and injected as few-shot demonstrations into the prompt, but the model call now runs on the champion LoRA adapter (fine-tuned base) rather than the stock model — re-homing the RAG in-context topology onto the fine-tuned weights.
result: Scored 0.498 on the full-30 gate (1 win / 13 ties / 15 losses vs Sonnet) with all rubric dimensions (atom, spec, cover, nat, nonRed) at 4 and specPass 100% — a new best, confirming that layering RAG exemplars onto the champion adapter yields a meaningful gain over the adapter alone. KEPT as the new champion.
